LESSON: READING 10.2.1 STUDY SKILLS: NOTE MAKING

Grade: Grade 8
Subject: ENGLISH
Strand: Strand 10
Topic 10.2: Reading 10.2.1 Study Skills: Note Making

SECTION 1: WELCOME

Hello! This is a study lesson on Reading 10.2.1 Study Skills: Note Making. Read the explanation, follow every worked example, then do the practice. This is original CBC Learn content written from KICD outcomes — not a copy of a commercial textbook.

Big question: How do we determine what to include in our notes during note making?

SECTION 2: WHAT YOU WILL LEARN

By the end of this lesson, you will be able to:

1. identify key points in a text
2. appreciate the importance of note making in learning

SECTION 3: STUDY NOTES (READ AND LEARN)

WHAT YOU ARE LEARNING: READING 10.2.1 STUDY SKILLS: NOTE MAKING
This lesson teaches Reading 10.2.1 Study Skills: Note Making for Grade 8 ENGLISH.

STUDY STEPS
1. identify key points in a text
   Practise this until you can do it without help.
2. appreciate the importance of note making in learning
   Practise this until you can do it without help.

HOW TO SHOW UNDERSTANDING
Explain the idea in your own words, give one Kenyan example, then complete the practice tasks.

SECTION 4: QUICK EXAMPLES

Example 1: Describe Reading 10.2.1 Study Skills: Note Making using something at your school.

Example 2: Give a home/community example from your county.

Example 3: Teach a younger child one idea from this lesson in simple words.

SECTION 5: PRACTICE NOW

1. Underline the key ideas about Reading 10.2.1 Study Skills: Note Making above.
2. Explain Reading 10.2.1 Study Skills: Note Making to a parent using one local example.
3. Write or draw three things that prove you understand Reading 10.2.1 Study Skills: Note Making.

SECTION 6: WORK TO DO (HOME / REVISION)

1. Write five sentences about Reading 10.2.1 Study Skills: Note Making with school or home examples.
2. Answer: Why is Reading 10.2.1 Study Skills: Note Making important for a Grade 8 learner?
3. Prepare a one-minute oral presentation for a parent or teacher.

SECTION: THINK ABOUT IT

1. How do we determine what to include in our notes during note making?
2. What is the importance of note making?

SECTION: REMEMBER

1. identify key points in a text
2. appreciate the importance of note making in learning

Now complete the Revision Quiz. Open Answers only after you finish.
